definitions.flow: Net money flow (Rs crore) = sum over a group's stocks of close x volume x sign(close - previous close). A market-activity proxy for money moving into or out of a group: it is not FII/DII data. True FII/DII sector flows are published only fortnightly by NSDL.
definitions.yday: The previous trading session, same formula.
definitions.avg9: Average daily net flow over the 9 sessions before today (today excluded, so it is not diluted by itself).
definitions.turnover: Traded value (close x volume) today divided by the 9-session average traded value; above 1.0x = busier than usual.
definitions.adv: % of the group's stocks that closed above the previous close.
definitions.chg: Equal-weighted average % change of the group's stocks (not market-cap weighted).
definitions.delivery: Delivery % is not shown: NSE delivery (bhavcopy) files cannot be fetched reliably from CI.
definitions.source: Daily bars from Yahoo Finance (delayed); constituents from NSE index lists.
